content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently using the demo version of [product_name] [version_no]. I'm not sure if that is causing an issue. At the moment, I can only see one page available in ladder view. Is there a way to add more ladder lines or pages? Thanks.

Hi [user_name], In the diagram editor, click on the 'Page Layout' button, which is shown as a square with the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 on it (please see the attached screenshot). You can increase the number of horizontal or vertical windows from there. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user reported seeing only one page available in the ladder view of [product_name] [version_no] while using the demo version. They were uncertain if this restriction was related to demo limitations or a general software feature, suggesting ambiguity around interface options and demo boundaries.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for the ability to add more ladder lines or pages in the ladder view, desiring increased flexibility and more options for diagram construction.
